tools.name: rf2_status
tools.description: Read exact native capabilities and limits

tools.name: rf2_check
tools.description: Validate Core or Compact V1, including scalar helpers

tools.name: rf2_run
tools.description: Execute bounded Core or Compact V1 in the native runtime

tools.name: rf2_lower
tools.description: Return checked per-program systems kernel source; no files are written or compiled

tools.name: attendance_export
tools.description: attendance.local@1: validate up to 1000 records, reject duplicate student/day, return CSV and counts. No filesystem access.

tools.name: invoice_total
tools.description: invoice.total@1: execute a compact rf2 app v1 invoice plan. Positive integer quantities, u32 cents, explicit basis-point tax and half-up invoice rounding. No file writes or tax advice.

tools.name: invoice_prepare
tools.description: Check an immutable invoice plan. Up to 32 process-local handles; returns visible currency/tax rules. No user files.

tools.name: invoice_apply
tools.description: Apply a prepared invoice plan in this server process. No rule overrides or user files.

tools.name: invoice_release
tools.description: Release a process-local invoice plan; later use fails.
